title: Games Should Not Cost $60 Anymore - Inflation, Microtransactions, and Publishing - Extra Credits
summary: Extra Credits explains from a game developer's perspective why AAA games have stayed at $60 despite inflation, and how that pressure drives DLC, microtransactions and loot boxes.
why: HN uses it as a short explanation of AAA pricing economics in discussions of microtransactions and game pricing.

quote.text: This 6 min video explains from game dev perspective why (AAA) games have been pegged at $60 on release
